KeysToEntries.Garou.House.Gone.1: The home you once built me is now gone.
KeysToEntries.Garou.House.Complete.1: I can sense her happiness. Her calm. I cannot thank you enough, traveller.
KeysToEntries.Garou.QuestComplete.1: I can smell fresh timber on the wind. The house…it stands now, doesn’t it?
KeysToEntries.Garou.QuestComplete.2: You’ve done an old garou a great kindness. Thank you, traveller.
KeysToEntries.Garou.Return.1: Tell me…does the house stand yet on the cliffs?
KeysToEntries.Garou.Return.2: An old garou cannot build it alone. When the walls rise and the roof covers me, come speak to me.
KeysToEntries.Garou.NoSpace.1: I've got something for you - a thank you of sorts - but you're overburdened. Clear some space and then come back to see me.
KeysToEntries.Garou.Intro.3: My wife chose this beautiful spot on the cliffs overlooking the sea. She said it would be the perfect place for a little wooden home.
KeysToEntries.Garou.Intro.4: I always meant to build it for her, but time has made these old bones slow, and these eyes see nothing now.
KeysToEntries.Garou.Intro.5: It’s a beautiful place. I can hear the waves from here.
KeysToEntries.Garou.Intro.6: Would you help an old garou to build a wooden home that my wife would be proud of? Be sure it covers me.
KeysToEntries.Garou.House.Complete.2: I feel my wife's hand on my shoulder. I thought it was Death's at first, but it's not. It's her.
KeysToEntries.Garou.PostQuest.1: I remember when I first saw her. Someone had been stealing from our tribe. Taking meat and pelts.
KeysToEntries.Garou.PostQuest.2: I was posted as guard. She was so noisy, I was surprised that no one had heard her steal from us before.
KeysToEntries.Garou.PostQuest.3: Her eyes locked onto mine, but she didn't stop or run away. She continued to load herself with spoils while staring at me.
KeysToEntries.Garou.PostQuest.4: She kept that look until her last days. I saw it whenever she snatched food from my plate. And that was often.
KeysToEntries.Garou.PostQuest.5: Ah, Cliodhna. I still serve myself too much food. Always for you.
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.1: Could you tell me more about her?
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: An elder garou wants you to build a home that his late wife would be proud of.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.1: Build a wooden home around Caratacus the Elder.
KeysToEntries.Garou.Name: Caratacus the Elder
